contradiction_reread.prompt:
You are rereading one visible line from a modal Fitch-style proof.
This line is suspicious because negation-elimination text may have been placed into the formula field.
Return only JSON with keys: line_label, formula_text, justification_text, scope_role, confidence.
If the formula is a contradiction symbol, return formula_text as ⊥.
A contradiction line may be written as ⊥, _|_, _ | _, or a short vertical stroke above a short horizontal bar.
Do not place justification text such as ¬E 4,8 or ~E 4,8 into formula_text.
Keep the rule and citations in justification_text.
If the crop shows no contradiction symbol, return the visible formula honestly.
Current OCR hint: formula_text="□Q", justification_text="¬E 4,5". Use this only as a weak hint and prefer the image.

boxed_justification_head_reread.prompt:
You are rereading only the boxed justification text from one visible line of a modal Fitch-style proof.
The full line remains visible for context, but read only the red boxed justification region.
Return only JSON. Do not include markdown fences or explanation.
Return exactly one JSON object with these keys: "justification_text", "confidence".
Return the visible rule head and any visible citations from the box.
Do not include formula text from elsewhere on the line.
Prefer Unicode operators in rule names such as ∧E, →E, ¬I, ¬E, □I, and □E.
If the box does not contain a readable justification, return an empty justification_text.
Modal system: K
Include derived rules: no
